description: React component 'DeploymentsOverTime' that renders a responsive area chart showing deployment counts over time with selectable date ranges. It fetches deployment data from an API, processes it, and visualizes it using 'recharts'.

methods.name: withAlpha
methods.description: Converts a hex color to an rgba string with specified alpha transparency.

methods.name: toLocalDateString
methods.description: Converts a date/time value to a 'YYYY-MM-DD' string format.

methods.name: applyTimeRange
methods.description: Filters deployment data based on selected time range (7d, 30d, 90d, all).
